definitions.short: Bene-Jaakan , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H1142. Bene Yaaqan יַעֲָק֑ן בְּנֵי proper name, of a location a station of Israel in wilderness Num 33:31-32 , (= יעקן בני בְּאֵרוֺת Deut 10:6 q. v.; compare also יַעֲקָ֑ן 1Chr 1:42 = וַעֲקָ֑ן Gen 36:27 , & Di Num 33:31 ).
definitions.rootNote: from the plural of 1121 and 3292 ; sons of Yaakan;
